message.content: Halo! Untuk memeriksa ketersediaan ukuran XS, kami perlu memastikan akun Anda terautentikasi terlebih dahulu. Apakah Anda sudah login? Jika belum, silakan masukkan nama pengguna dan kata sandi Anda (atau beri tahu kami jika Anda ingin menggunakan opsi “remember me”). Kami akan membantu memeriksa stoknya setelah login.

The system has a function for user authentication. But the user didn't provide credentials. We might need to ask for login. But maybe we can respond: "Maaf, ukuran XS tidak tersedia." Or ask if they want to check inventory. We can ask for username/password. According to policy, we should not ask for credentials unless necessary. But we might need to authenticate to check inventory. We can ask them to log in. So respond: "Apakah Anda sudah login? Jika belum, silakan login." Or ask for credentials. Probably ask them to login.
